pathBase: Paths resolve from the repository root (the folder containing cases/ and skill/). Bare artifact names (spec.json, src/*, test/*, docs/*, public/sketch.*, requirements.lock, run-state.json) mean the active case directory cases/<slug>/; skill/sketch2sim/* and CHANGELOG.md mean the repository root. Every path in reads/writes/forbidden follows one of these two bases.

classification.scheduler: Coordinator — an LLM agent that only reads state and decides who to wake; never writes code/tests/spec; persistent
classification.executor: T0/T1/T2/T5 agents — LLM agents that produce concrete artifacts (spec/code/tests/lessons); T0/T1/T5 context destroyed after handoff; T2 (physics/shell) kept alive across the acceptance polish loop per destroyContextAfter flag
classification.machine: run-gates.mjs — NOT an LLM agent; a deterministic Node script that runs G0-G4 and writes run-state.json; no hallucination; structured whitelist in roles.machine (stage T3)

trigger.entry: Coordinator reads this file and dispatches T0; every IDE / LLM injects this JSON as the single role source
trigger.ideNote: Claude Code / Cursor / any LLM: load this JSON into context; role definitions, read/write whitelists and exit codes below are authoritative

exitCodes.0: PASS - delivered, pending user acceptance sign-off
exitCodes.1: A-class self-repair - wake dev agent with diagnostic summary only (≤3x)
exitCodes.2: tamper detected (hash mismatch) - freeze, fatal, never release
exitCodes.3: C-class deadlock (same fingerprint x3 / physical contradiction) - blockers.md, user decision
exitCodes.4: B-class change - write change-log.md, re-sign requirements.lock, reset counters

intake.responsibility: Require lock: read sketch, ≤3 Q&A, write spec.json + intake-questions.md, sign requirements.lock; C-class deadlock (Exit 3): write docs/blockers.md and ask user to choose; B-class change (Exit 4): re-edit spec.json + intake-questions.md and re-sign requirements.lock

auditor.responsibility: Independent test author: write test/verify.mjs (G3 assertions frozen first), sign verify.lock, sole report signer

physics.responsibility: Implement src/mechanism.js + headless probe(spec); constants derived by resolveParams pure function, no hand-copied numbers

shell.responsibility: Assemble 8-step Tour + resetAll() (linear+angular zeroed) + panel (90px slider, card-grid layout, global baseline alignment) + formula card

coordinator.responsibility: State machine holder (never destroyed); dispatch T0-T5; interpret exit codes; count retries; freeze/unfreeze; route T5 evolver after user acceptance

evolver.responsibility: Post-delivery retrospective (after user acceptance): distill cross-case lessons into skill/sketch2sim/references/ (tagged, provenance) and skill/sketch2sim/template/ (generic shell only); maintain root CHANGELOG
reviewRules: must come from a real FAIL/fix or C-class meltdown event

machine.responsibility: Deterministic Node judge (no LLM, no hallucination): run G0 hygiene → G1 traceability → G2 common template → G3 custom physics → G4 perturbation; compute error fingerprints; write run-state.json; output exit codes 0/1/2/3/4
